title: gnss_l76k.c: same Zephyr 4.1 modem_pipe arity + -Wswitch-enum breaks as gnss_ag3335 (gvf1) - migrates when CONFIG_GNSS_L76K=y
description: Found during gvf1 3x codereview (2 independent reviewer passes flagged it). lichen/drivers/gnss/gnss_l76k.c carries the identical two Zephyr 4.1 break classes just fixed in gnss_ag3335.c: (1) modem_pipe_open(data->uart_pipe) at :152 and modem_pipe_close(data->uart_pipe) at :160/:216 still use the removed single-arg pre-4.1 API (pipe.h:99/176 now require k_timeout_t) -> hard compile error; (2) gnss_l76k_pm_action at :223-232 uses default: on enum pm_device_action, naming only 2 of 4 members (missing PM_DEVICE_ACTION_TURN_ON/TURN_OFF) -> fatal under -Werror -Wswitch-enum (lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt:52,113). Fix mirrors gvf1: add K_SECONDS(10) to the three pipe calls; convert default: to explicit PM_DEVICE_ACTION_TURN_ON/PM_DEVICE_ACTION_TURN_OFF cases + trailing return -ENOTSUP. Latent today (CONFIG_GNSS_L76K=y in no current app conf; AG3335 is the t1000_e part) but the gnss_l76k native_sim test overlays enable the DT node, so the first L76K-enabled build against 4.1 fails in 4 places. Relates to project-LICHEN-worker6-jtl6 (L76K build validation). Verify with a native_sim or ARM build enabling CONFIG_GNSS_L76K.
